# Vocabulary.com

> > Vocabulary.com is an adaptive learning platform that helps students and educators master English vocabulary through an intelligent dictionary, personalized learning exercises, and competitive word games.

The platform combines a comprehensive English dictionary with engaging educational tools like Vocabulary Bowl and Vocab Jam competitions. Vocabulary.com uses adaptive learning technology to help users of all ages improve their word knowledge and language skills through interactive games and teacher-guided classroom activities.
